entities.summary: Kyoto University of Foreign Studies , also known as KUFS, is a foreign language university in Kyoto, Japan. Kyoto Junior College of Foreign Languages is attached to this university. KUFS specializes in 9 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Chinese, Italian, Russian, and Japanese. In addition, a faculty of global engagement that includes global studies and global tourism.
